routes.description: Establish that mechanistic cosmology does not exhaust the question of existence, then argue that the universe's life-permitting, intelligible, law-governed, and information-bearing character is better accounted for by a fundamental rational mind, with revelation identifying the proposed creator.
routes.successCriteria: The route succeeds if the combined case makes divine mind a warranted explanation of why a comprehensible, life-permitting universe exists while answering naturalistic objections from selection effects, physical origin models, cosmic scale, and evidential standards.

motionBridge.description: Connect the universe's existence and salient structure to purposive agency without treating the creator as a substitute for ordinary physical mechanisms.

centralBridges.description: Show that physical accounts of how cosmic states develop leave a distinct burden concerning why any universe, laws, or productive physical states exist.
Show that life-permitting conditions require an explanation not supplied merely by the fact that observers can observe only compatible conditions.
Relate the rational intelligibility, lawfulness, and information-bearing features of nature to a rational source while addressing matter-first alternatives.

subsidiaryBridges.description: Explain why cosmic scale, hostility, and limited biological distribution do not by themselves defeat purposive creation or human significance.
Supply a basis for identifying the proposed creator and defend the admissibility of historical or revelatory evidence alongside evidence from nature.

routes.description: Require independent, testable evidence before inferring cosmic purpose, show that apparent design and intelligibility admit natural or selection-based accounts, and present physical cosmology as capable of explaining the observed universe without requiring divine agency.
routes.successCriteria: The route succeeds if current cosmology and natural processes adequately account for the relevant observations while the proposed purposive inference remains unsupported, presupposes purpose, exceeds the evidence, or depends on prior religious commitments.

motionBridge.description: Establish that the observed universe can be investigated and accounted for through physical processes without evidential need for a divine mind.

centralBridges.description: Require purpose to be independently demonstrated rather than built into why-questions or inferred from humanity's presence in the universe.
Show that observer selection, uncertain possibilities for life, and non-optimal cosmic conditions block a necessary inference from fine-tuning to design.
Provide a physically coherent account under which a universe may arise without a prior universe and clarify the physical senses assigned to nothing.
Apply observational, testable, and falsifiable standards to cosmological and supernatural claims without relying on personal authority.

subsidiaryBridges.description: Explain reliable human reasoning and comprehension through evolved physical minds whose predictions are checked against observation.
Examine whether revelation, miracle claims, historical documents, and antecedent religious commitments independently support the cosmological inference.

sections.title: Existence, Nothing, and the Reach of Physical Cosmology
sections.rationale: This issue bears directly on whether a physical account of cosmic emergence answers the motion or leaves a further explanatory burden concerning why any universe, laws, or physical states exist.

sections.title: Fine-Tuning, Selection Effects, and Life-Permitting Conditions
sections.rationale: The design inference depends substantially on whether life-compatible parameters demand purposive explanation or are adequately addressed by observer selection, alternative possibilities, and the universe's limited hospitality to life.

sections.title: Cosmic Intelligibility, Natural Law, and Information
sections.rationale: This section tests whether rational comprehensibility, dependable cognition, law-governed order, and biological information support mind as fundamental or remain explicable within a physical evolutionary account.

sections.title: Cosmic Purpose, Scale, and Human Significance
sections.rationale: Claims about purpose must address whether cosmic vastness, hostility, inefficiency, and the distribution of life undermine human-centered design or are compatible with value that is not measured by physical scale.

sections.title: Standards of Evidence, Revelation, and Supernatural Claims
sections.rationale: The competing accounts rely on different views of admissible evidence, making testability, miracles, historical documents, scientific authority, revelation, and prior commitments material to whether either worldview is supported.

chunk-001:c002.proposition: Scientific accounts of how the universe works do not displace the distinct question of why it exists or whether a personal agent purposed it.

chunk-001:c004.proposition: Nature's rational intelligibility supports purpose, while treating human minds as products of a purposeless naturalistic process raises a question about trusting their reasoning.

chunk-001:c007.proposition: Cosmic size and duration do not determine human value, and Christian revelation presents the universe as a home for human beings made in God's image.

chunk-001:c009.proposition: Miracles are special divine actions within a universe of regularities, and their categorical rejection reflects an antecedent exclusion of the supernatural.

chunk-002:c002-02.proposition: The fact that observers must inhabit a life-permitting universe does not explain why such a universe exists or remove the fine-tuning question.

chunk-002:c002-04.proposition: Because the universe need not have been rationally comprehensible, its actual intelligibility and our partial understanding of it reasonably point toward a rational creator.

chunk-002:c002-09.proposition: A universe from nothing is not established when proposed accounts redefine nothing as physical states that retain structure rather than the absence of anything, including space.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-07.proposition: Christian belief does not rest solely on cosmic origins but claims a cumulative evidential basis in Jesus's life, death and resurrection and in experienced relationship with God.

chunk-001:c003.proposition: Asking why the universe exists presupposes a purpose that must first be independently established rather than built into the question.

chunk-001:c005.proposition: Evolved physical minds can understand their natural environment, while successful observational predictions provide an empirical basis for trusting their reasoning.

chunk-001:c006.proposition: A vast universe that is largely hostile to known life provides no warrant for assuming human-centered creation and counts against an efficiently designed cosmos.

chunk-001:c010.proposition: Claims that natural laws were miraculously suspended require scientifically testable evidence and should not be accepted merely through hearsay or faith.

chunk-002:c002-01.proposition: Apparent fine-tuning does not establish design because observer selection, uncertainty about possible life, and the universe's poor optimization for life undermine that inference.

chunk-002:c002-03.proposition: Physical parameters can make life possible while also producing lifeless structures and destructive events, so life need not be their guiding purpose.

chunk-002:c002-06.proposition: The genetic code's importance to terrestrial biology does not make biological information a central governing principle of the mostly gene-free universe.

chunk-002:c002-07.proposition: Known physics makes emergence of the observed kind of universe without prior matter or a prior universe plausible, although the proposal remains unproved.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-04.proposition: Cosmological claims should be assessed through physical, falsifiable, testable evidence rather than quotations from scientists treated as authorities.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-06.proposition: Current knowledge of the universe provides no evidence that a god is needed to produce it, without thereby asserting that no god exists.
